_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 10.6.0, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en:
The running timer on your lock screen and in a home screen widget, kept current with end-to-end encryption
Stop the timer or start the next Pomodoro phase from a notification or widget, without opening the app
The timer always in sight on your desktop, with shortcuts that work in every app
Knowledge base: page versions, favourites and recently opened pages
Many smaller fixes and improvements
de:
Der laufende Timer auf dem Sperrbildschirm und als Widget, Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselt aktuell gehalten
Timer stoppen oder die nächste Pomodoro-Phase starten, direkt aus Mitteilung oder Widget, ohne die App zu öffnen
Der Timer am Desktop immer im Blick, mit Tastenkürzeln, die in jeder App funktionieren
Wissensdatenbank: Seitenversionen, Favoriten und zuletzt geöffnete Seiten
Viele kleinere Korrekturen und Verbesserungen
